normalization: Portable path placeholders and descriptive labels, with original and public uncompressed hashes. Archives opened recursively; members normalized individually, then recompressed as xz. Numeric outcomes, native type shapes and failing exits are retained. Excerpts and omissions are explicit.

omissions.reason: Application copies, compiler binaries, dependency caches and large app caches omitted; input/compiler/binary/cache hashes and all completed command reports retained.
